Big Tech Companies May Face Billion-Dollar Fines After Australia Passes ‘Digital Duty of Care’ Law

Tech giants could face penalties of up to 5% of their global revenue if found in violation of new online safety rules in Australia. The country’s Parliament passed the Digital Duty of Care bill Wednesday, Communications Minister Anika Wells said , after the center-left Labor Party government of Prime Minister Anthony Albanese reached a deal with the left-wing Greens party.
